notes: Two judgment calls flagged in unit notes: 'in that' as added, and בְּעֵת fused onto 'when'.

The fusion at s013/s014 is the right reading under rule 30, which fuses a preposition before a construct noun on the same terms as לִפְנֵי -> 'before' when only one English word is written; rule 52's split applies where a word is spent on each morpheme, as in לְקוֹל תִּתּוֹ -> 'When he uttereth his voice'.
